title: Parameter isolation with domain-specific experts for incremental audio classification
abstract: arXiv:2609.14730v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: To successfully deploy a model in time-varying environments such as streaming data prediction and sensing control, domain-incremental learning (DIL) has attracted attention since it aims to adapt a previously trained model to newly arriving domains, while reserving knowledge from earlier domains without accessing their data. Incremental learning across domains can be regarded as a recurrent update, in which the current model is obtained by updating the model carried over from previous domains. Conventional DIL approaches that rely on domain-invariant feature learning and weight regularization gradually overwrite or constrain parameters learned in previous domains, leading to catastrophic forgetting. Instead, this paper proposes a new domain-specific parameter-isolation architecture that retains all past domains. The proposed architecture mitigates catastrophic forgetting through a full-order recurrent update, constructing a new expert

translated_title: 基于领域特定专家的参数隔离方法用于增量音频分类
translated_abstract: 为了在流数据预测和传感控制等时变环境中成功部署模型，领域增量学习（DIL）受到了广泛关注，因为它旨在使先前训练的模型适应新到达的领域，同时在无法访问早期领域数据的情况下保留其知识。跨领域的增量学习可以被视为一种循环更新，其中当前模型是通过更新从前一领域延续下来的模型而获得的。传统的DIL方法依赖于领域不变特征学习和权重正则化，会逐渐覆盖或约束先前领域学习到的参数，从而导致灾难性遗忘。与此不同，本文提出了一种新的领域特定参数隔离架构，该架构能够保留所有过去领域的信息。所提出的架构通过全阶循环更新来构建新的专家，从而缓解灾难性遗忘问题。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于领域特定专家的参数隔离架构，通过全阶循环更新保留所有过去领域的知识，有效缓解领域增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提升增量音频分类性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a domain-specific parameter-isolation architecture that mitigates catastrophic forgetting in domain-incremental learning by retaining knowledge from all past domains through full-order recurrent updates, improving incremental audio classification performance.
